abstract: React Native code-quality guide for Scotia Móvil MX projects: side effects and cleanup, hooks, context typing and reactivity, styles, hardcoded colors, lists, re-renders, components, RHF/Yup API usage, async error handling, navigation typing, animations, logging, pnpm security and dates (Date vs Intl.DateTimeFormat per usage, parsing, locale and time zone, date math, formatter reuse, date libraries — evaluated before applying). 62 rules in 11 categories (Components, TypeScript, State and Hooks, Styles, Lists, Performance, APIs and Data, Navigation, Animations, Conventions, Dates). v2 is token-optimized: a zero-dependency Node scanner (scripts/scan.mjs, optional ESLint merge) runs every detection and produces the pre-change summary, rules for libraries not installed are N/A automatically, a per-project profile (.scotia-audit/profile.md, shared with the architecture package) replaces repo exploration, the default scope is the diff against the base branch, and skipped findings go to a baseline. Naming, folders and layers belong to react-native-scotia-movil-mx-architecture-skills.
